Gọi $A$: "xã A có mưa"; $B$: "xã B có mưa".\\
		$A \cup B$: "Ít nhất một trong hai xã có mưa".\\
		Theo đề bài, ta có $P(AB) = 10\% = 0{,}1$, $P(\overline{A} \mid \overline{B}) = 65\% = 0{,}65$; $P(\overline{B} \mid \overline{A}) = 60\% = 0{,}6$.\\
		Mặt khác $P\left((A \cup B) \cup (\overline{A}\overline{B})\right) = 1$.\\
		Giả sử $P(A \cup B) = x \Rightarrow P(\overline{A}\overline{B}) = 1 - x$.\\
		Ta có $P(\overline{A}) = \displaystyle \frac{P(\overline{A}\overline{B})}{P(\overline{B} \mid \overline{A})} = \displaystyle \frac{1-x}{0{,}6} \Rightarrow P(A) = 1 - P(\overline{A}) = 1 - \displaystyle \frac{1-x}{0{,}6}$.\\
		$P(\overline{B}) = \displaystyle \frac{P(\overline{A}\overline{B})}{P(\overline{A} \mid \overline{B})} = \displaystyle \frac{1-x}{0{,}65} \Rightarrow P(B) = 1 - P(\overline{B}) = 1 - \displaystyle \frac{1-x}{0{,}65}$.\\
		Ta lại có $P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(AB)$\\
		Hay $x = 1 - \displaystyle \frac{1-x}{0{,}6} + 1 - \displaystyle \frac{1-x}{0{,}65} - 0{,}1 \Rightarrow x = \displaystyle \frac{509}{860} \approx 0{,}59$. Vậy $P(A \cup B) = x \approx 0{,}59$.
